question: Which of the following states has been allotted second highest number of seats in Rajya Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Maharashtra.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **vice president of India serves as the ex-officio **chairman of the** Rajya Sabha**.
 
• The House also elects a** deputy chairman from among its members. **
 
• The** Lok Sabha House can hold a maximum of 552 members**, with 530 representing the states, 20 the Union Territories, and two chosen by the **President from the Anglo-Indian population.**
 
• Currently, there are **545 members of the Lok Sabha**, 530 of whom were elected directly from states and** 13 from union territories.**
 
• 
 
With **80 seats, Uttar Pradesh** has the most in the Lok Sabha.** 48 Lok Sabha seats are in Maharashtra. **

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the** union legislature of the Indian federal system**, the Rajya Sabha represents the states (hence the name, Council of States).

 The Rajya Sabha is therefore qualified to protect state rights **against the federal government.**
 
• The **Rajya Sabha is referred to as a permanent house** because it is an ongoing body that cannot be dissolved. The **Lok Sabha** is the only body that can be dissolved.
 
• The **lower house of India's bicameral Parliament **is known as the Lok Sabha, officially known as the House of the People. The Rajya Sabha is the name of the **upper house. **
